a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Roger. Clock.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Roger. We got a roll program.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Roger. Roll. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000.text: Neil Armstrong reporting their roll and pitch program which puts Apollo 11 on a proper heading. Plus 30 seconds.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Roll's complete and the pitch is programming. [Pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000.text: One Bravo is a abort control mode.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Apollo 11, Houston. You're good at 1 minute.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000.text: We're through the region of maximum dynamic pressure now.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Stand by for Mode One-Charlie.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Mark.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Mode One-Charlie.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: One-Charlie.

a11_0000000.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000.text: Cliff Charlesworth taking a staging status.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for staging. [Pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Inboard cut-off.

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: We confirm inboard cut-off. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000.text: Downrange 35 [nautical] miles [65 km], 30 [nautical] miles [56 km] high. Standing by for the outboard engine cut-down [means "shutdown"] now.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Staging.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: And ignition. [Pause.]

a11_0000000.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000.text: 11, Houston. Thrust is Go, all engines. You're looking good.

a11_0000000.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000.text: Ah, Roger. You're loud and clear, Houston. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000000ag.text: This is Apollo Control at 23 minutes, 52 seconds. Canary Islands station has Loss Of Signal from Apollo 11. We have a tape of the air/ground [communication] during the launch phase. We'll play that for you now.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000ag.text: Roger. We got a roll program.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000ag.text: Roll's complete and the pitch is programming. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, Houston. You're good at 1 minute.

a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for staging. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.text: 11, Houston. Thrust is Go, all engines. You're looking good.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000ag.text: Ah, Roger. You're loud and clear, Houston. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.text: Houston, be advised the visual is Go today.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Collins
a11_0000000ag.text: Yeah, they finally gave me a window to look out. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: 11, Houston. Your guidance has converged; you're looking good.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: 11, Houston. You are Go at 4 minutes.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: 11, Houston. You are Go at 5 minutes.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Stand by for S-IVB to COI capability.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Collins
a11_0000000ag.text: You sure sound clear down there, Bruce. Sounds like you're sitting in your living room.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Ah, thank you. You all are coming through beautifully, too. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000ag.text: We're Go at 6 minutes. Starting the gimbal motors.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Roger, 11. You're Go from the ground at 6 minutes. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: 11, this is Houston. Roger. You're Go from the ground at 7 minutes. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, Houston. You are Go at 8 minutes.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000000ag.text: Ah, just got the mixture ratio shift.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Roger. We got PU shift down here, too. [Pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: Collins
a11_0000000ag.text: Well, it looks like a nice day for it. These thunderstorms downrange is about all.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: 11, this is Houston. You are Go for staging. Over.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Stand by for Mode IV capability.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Ignition confirmed. Thrust is Go, 11. [Long pause.]

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. At 10 minutes, you are Go.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Predicted cut-off at 11 plus 42. Over.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go at 11.

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Roger. Shutdown. We copy 101.4 by 103.6 [nautical miles, 187.8 by 191.9 km].

a11_0000000ag.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000000ag.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are confirmed Go for orbit.

a11_t-0000135.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0000135.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for staging. [Pause.]

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0000135.text: Downrange 35 [nautical] miles [65 km], 30 [nautical] miles [56 km] high. Standing by for the outboard engine cut-down [means "shutdown"] now.

a11_t-0000135.text: 11, Houston. Thrust is Go, all engines. You're looking good.

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0000135.text: Ah, Roger. You're loud and clear, Houston. [Pause.]

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0000135.text: At 3 minutes; downrange, 70 [nautical] miles [130 km]; 43 [nautical] miles high [80 km]; velocity, 9,300 feet per second [2,835 m/s].

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0000135.text: Neil Armstrong confirming both the engine skirt separation and the launch escape tower separation.

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0000135.text: Houston, be advised the visual is Go today.

a11_t-0000135.text: Yeah, they finally gave me a window to look out. [Pause.]

a11_t-0000135.text: 11, Houston. Your guidance has converged; you're looking good.

a11_t-0000135.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0000135.text: Downrange, 140 [nautical] miles [259 km]; altitude, 62 [nautical] miles [115 km]; velocity, 10,300 feet per second [3,140 m/s].

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Ah, Roger. You're loud and clear, Houston. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.text: We got skirt sep.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Roger. We confirm skirt sep.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Tower's gone.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Roger, tower. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Neil Armstrong confirming both the engine skirt separation and the launch escape tower separation.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Houston, be advised the visual is Go today.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: This is Houston. Roger. Out.

a11_0000255.text: Yeah, they finally gave me a window to look out. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Downrange, 140 [nautical] miles [259 km]; altitude, 62 [nautical] miles [115 km]; velocity, 10,300 feet per second [3,140 m/s].

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: 11, Houston. You are Go at 4 minutes.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11 right on the ground track.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: 11, Houston. You are Go at 5 minutes.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Roger. It'll - Apollo 11. Go. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Downrange, 270 [nautical] miles [500 km]; altitude, 82 [nautical] miles [152 km]; velocity, 12,472 feet per second [3,801 m/s].

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Stand by for S-IVB to COI capability.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Okay.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Mark. S-IVB to COI capability.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Roger.

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11 could now get into orbit using the S-IVB if necessary.

a11_0000255.speaker: Collins
a11_0000255.text: You sure sound clear down there, Bruce. Sounds like you're sitting in your living room.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Ah, thank you. You all are coming through beautifully, too. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: We're Go at 6 minutes. Starting the gimbal motors.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Roger, 11. You're Go from the ground at 6 minutes. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Level sense arm is the sequence that arranges the staging between the second stage and the third stage. The fuel uncovers a sensor starting that sequence. Predicting that will be uncovered at 8 minutes, 17 seconds with outboard engine cut-off 9 minutes, 11 seconds on the second stage.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11's Go at 7 minutes.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: 11, this is Houston. Roger. You're Go from the ground at 7 minutes. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11 is still right down the ground track. Still Go at 7 minutes, 41 seconds.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Inboard cut-off.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Roger. We confirmed. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Inboard engines are out, on the second stage as planned.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Apollo 11, Houston. You are Go at 8 minutes.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Ah, just got the mixture ratio shift.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Roger. We got PU shift down here, too. [Pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Collins
a11_0000255.text: Well, it looks like a nice day for it. These thunderstorms downrange is about all.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: 11, this is Houston. You are Go for staging. Over.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Understand, Go for staging. And...

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Stand by for Mode IV capability.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Okay. Mode IV.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Mark.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Mode IV capability. [Long pause.]

a11_0000255.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0000255.text: Mode IV on Apollo 11 could get into orbit using the Service Propulsion System now. Altitude is 100 miles, downrange is 883 miles. Outboard engine cut-off.

a11_0000255.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0000255.text: Staging, and ignition.

a11_0000255.speaker: McCandless
a11_0000255.text: Ignition confirmed. Thrust is Go, 11. [Long pause.]

a11_t-0000415.text: Ah, thank you. You all are coming through beautifully, too. [Long pause.]

a11_t-0000415.text: Everyone is reporting Go here in the Control Center.

a11_t-0000415.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0000415.text: We're Go at 6 minutes. Starting the gimbal motors.

a11_t-0000415.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0000415.text: Roger, 11. You're Go from the ground at 6 minutes. [Long pause.]

a11_t-0000415.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11. [Long pause.]

a11_t-0000415.text: 11, this is Houston. Roger. You're Go from the ground at 7 minutes. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11.

a11_t-0000600.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11. [Long pause.]

a11_t-0000600.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0000600.text: 11, this is Houston. Roger. You're Go from the ground at 7 minutes. Level sense arm at 8 plus 17; outboard cut-off at 9 plus 11.

a11_t-0000600.text: Downrange, 530 [nautical] miles [982 km]; altitude, 95 [nautical] miles [176 km]; velocity, 17,358 feet per second [5,291 m/s].

a11_t-0000600.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0000600.text: Apollo 11 is still right down the ground track. Still Go at 7 minutes, 41 seconds.

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. At 10 minutes, you are Go.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Ah, roger. 11's Go. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001001.text: Capcom Bruce McCandless giving the reports here from the Control Center.

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Predicted cut-off at 11 plus 42. Over.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: 11:42. Rog. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001001.text: Downrange, 1,175 [nautical] miles [2,176 km]; velocity, 24,190 mile - feet per second [7,373 m/s]; altitude, 102 nautical miles [189 km].

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go at 11.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: That's a Go. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Shutdown.

a11_0001001.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001001.text: Shutdown right on time.

a11_0001001.speaker: Collins
a11_0001001.text: SECO. We are showing 101.4 by 103.6.

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Roger. Shutdown. We copy 101.4 by 103.6 [nautical miles, 187.8 by 191.9 km].

a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are confirmed Go for orbit.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001001.text: We show insert...

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. The booster is safe.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Ah, roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001001.text: We show velocity at insertion, 25,568 feet per second [7,793 m/s].

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. The booster has been configured for orbital coast. Both spacecraft are looking good. Over.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0001001.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001001.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Vanguard LOS at 15:35. AOS Canaries at 16:30. Over.

a11_0001001.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001001.text: Okay. Thank you.

a11_t-0001100.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0001100.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go at 11.

a11_t-0001100.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0001100.text: We're predicting third stage shutdown at 11 minutes, 42 seconds. Velocity 25,254 feet per second [7,697 km]. Downrange, 1,400 [nautical] miles [2,593 km] now. Altitude 102.8 nautical miles [190.4 km].

a11_t-0001100.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0001100.text: Roger. Shutdown. We copy 101.4 by 103.6 [nautical miles, 187.8 by 191.9 km].

a11_t-0001100.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0001100.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are confirmed Go for orbit.

a11_0001738.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0001738.text: Uh, you... Houston Comm Tech. Canary Comm Tech.

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston through Canary. Over.

a11_0001738.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0001738.text: Roger. Reading you loud and clear. Our insertion checklist is complete, and we have no abnormalities.

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Roger. And I'd like to pass up your Delta Azimuth correction at this time if you're ready to copy.

a11_0001738.speaker: Collins
a11_0001738.text: Roger. Go ahead. Ready to copy.

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Okay. Delta azimuth correction is plus 0.22, that is plus .22, and we do recommend the P52 alignment. Over.

a11_0001738.speaker: Collins
a11_0001738.text: Okay. We'll go ahead with the P52, and deflecting angle [Delta Azimuth] plus 0.22.

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Roger. And your LOS time at Canary is 23:37. Over.

a11_0001738.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0001738.text: This is Apollo Control. Based on that initial orbital figures, the orbital period is 1 hour, 28 minutes, 16 seconds. This number will be refined as - also as we get better information on the orbit through radar tracking. At the present time, we're showing an orbital period of 1 hour, 28 minutes, 17 seconds. We'll continue to stand by live through the Canary Station.

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. One minute to LOS Canary. AOS at Tananarive 37:04 in VHF Simplex Alpha. Over. [Long pause.]

a11_0001738.speaker: McCandless
a11_0001738.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Coming up on LOS Canary. AOS Tananarive at 37:04, Simplex Alpha. Houston. Out.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: How are we doing on that time, anybody? Neil, are you sort of master of ceremonies on time, yet?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: Well, I didn't...

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: [Singing] Okay, your Drinking Water Supply valve is On.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: How about this [garble] circuit configuration? Glycol Reservoir Bypass valve, Open?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: [Cough] Okay, we're ready for them. Bypass is Open.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Reservoir Out valve, Closed?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: Out's Closed.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: In valve, Closed?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: In's Closed.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: ECS Radiator Flow Control, Primary.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: [Garble].

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Hey, Buzz?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: How would you like the camera?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Okay.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Primary Glycol to Radiator valve, Normal.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Where did I leave the dark slide?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: Are we ready for that, you think? What's the time?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: 30 minutes. [Garble].

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: [Garble] to Normal, and check the radiator.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: It will take a while, that's...

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Okay, now, is that normal for the discharge pressure to zap down low and to do that? Do you think, Mike?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: What's that? I'm sorry, I wasn't listening.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: When Neil sends the Glycol Radiators to Normal, temporarily, it...

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: It drops?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: The temperature done that?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong/Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: No, the pressure.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah, pressure - you might get a little drop in it, I don't really know, but it came back up.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yes, it goes back up.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Alright, Buzz, here's one Hasselblad for you. Coming around the right-hand couch.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: Seems OK.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Buzz?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah, just a second.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: I'll just let go of it, Buzz. It will be hanging over here in the air. Coming up, it's occupying my couch.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Okay.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Just leave the dark slide with it?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Well, I thought about [garble] the dark slide or something, and then I thought we might need it later for a magazine change, so I left it with it.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Well, I know there's an orange dot on this [garble] somewhere.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin

a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah, I guess it's 5 minutes after you do this before [garble].

a11_0002853ob.text: It's, it's coming down, but it's...

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0002853ob.text: Is it?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: ...as I said before, that's...

a11_0002853ob.text: And the bracket - bracket slide...

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: Could you - Can you work on that strap?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Oh, yeah, I will. Sure will. The - the one that your strut's off [garble] instrument panel.

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah. [Garble].

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0002853ob.text: And you're happy with that?

a11_0002853ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0002853ob.text: Yeah.

a11_0002853ob.text: This is Apollo Control at 36 minutes. That's the end of the tape. We have a report on the launch heart rates now from the flight surgeon. Commander Neil Armstrong's heart rate, 110; Command Module Pilot Mike Collins, 99; Lunar Module Pilot Buzz Aldrin, 88. These compare with their first Gemini flights, their first lift-off back in the Gemini program: Armstrong's heart rate was 146 at that time, Collins was 125, Aldrin was 110. a11_0010248.text: Let...let me tell them about the TV...

a11_0010248.speaker: Collins
a11_0010248.text: Roger, Bruce. Thank you. We expect TV. We've got it all hooked up. We have not yet turned it on. We're ready to do that now.

a11_0010248.speaker: McCandless
a11_0010248.text: Roger. We copy. We'll be configured and waiting for whatever you want to send down.

a11_0010248.speaker: Collins
a11_0010248.text: Okay, you think we can do that?

a11_0010248.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0010248.text: That's fine with us.

a11_0010248.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0010248.text: This one here?

a11_0010248.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0010248.text: Tell them that we've got nothing to do here but re-check it here for the next 20 minutes or so.

a11_0010248.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0010248.text: Okay. I'm ready to turn the TV on. Play with it [garble] flashlight [garble] hook it up [garble].

a11_0010248.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0010248.text: This is Apollo Control at 1 hour, 6 minutes into the mission of Apollo 11. Honeysuckle has Loss Of Signal. Mike Collins reported just prior to LOS here that the crew would check out the TV camera at the Goldstone station. Goldstone will acquire Apollo 11 at 1 hour, 29 minutes, 2 seconds; and will lose the spacecraft at 1 hour, 33 minutes, 55 seconds. We'll come back up just shortly prior to acquisition at Goldstone. This is Mission Control, Houston.

a11_0010248.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0010248.text: Want a - [garble]? Mike?

a11_0010248.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0010248.text: No.

a11_0010248.speaker: Collins
a11_0010248.text: Yes, I'd love one, Neil, thank you. I just stuck it in my pocket.

a11_0010248.speaker: Collins
a11_0010248.text: Can I give you the wrapping back?

a11_0010248.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0010248.text: [Laughing] Now that is a problem, trying to find...

a11_0010248.speaker: Collins
a11_0010248.text: It's a gooey one. Gooey when the paper doesn't want to come off, but thanks anyway.

a11_0010248.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0010248.text: ... something about the [garble]...

a11_0010248.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0010248.text: It's a...

a11_0010248.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0010248.text: No, I think it's...

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0011155.text: Yes. You want to see the monitor?

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: Is this all ready to go? I'm going to put it back over here. It's over here under your stuff. Now, it seems to me if Buzz wants his camera to drift up, so what I ought to do is probably - Hey, Buzz!

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: Hey, it seemed to stick pretty well if you stood it up on the - with the lens kind of pointing out. There are two pieces of Velcro over there.

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: There are two pieces on the back of them [garble].

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: Yeah, over, just a little up toward the [garble].

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0011155.text: Now, [garble] - it's rolling around, so I can start looking outside, upside down.

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: I don't know, I think we'd almost be better just by looking at the monitor, Buzz.

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0011155.text: Yes, yes, but this way I think I'll know how to...

a11_t-0011155.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0011155.text: Are you going the right way for those hoses? It looks to me like you ought to roll over the other way.

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: Okay, that's good.

a11_0012800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0012800.text: How do you think we can...?

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: Yes, you can fold it flat. Would that help you?

a11_0012800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0012800.text: Yes.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: That's pull - pull...

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: See that, Buzz? You're a TV expert.

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: Now, the next big thing we got to do is, after the attitude reference check, is extend the docking probe. No big thing. Copy down a bunch of PADs and then you got your RCS hot-fire.

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: That booster, when that thing...

a11_0012800.speaker: McCandless
a11_0012800.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston through Guaymas. Over.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: Roger, Houston. Reading you loud and clear.

a11_0012800.speaker: McCandless
a11_0012800.text: Roger. Reading you the same. Coming up on AOS Goldstone.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: Roger. [Pause.]

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: It should be right now, Buzz.

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: Cecil B. DeAldrin is standing by for instructions.

a11_0012800.speaker: McCandless
a11_0012800.text: Houston. Roger.

a11_0012800.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0012800.text: We have no downlink yet at Goldstone. We're standing by.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: Okay, and I got PADs, need to extend the probe, and do an SM RCS hotfire.

a11_0012800.speaker: Collins
a11_0012800.text: That's right, that's the same way I read it. I don't know what this is, coming up.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: When you, when you come up on this SECS Logic, and MSFN Go for pyro arm, don't forget to get an Okay from them before you send the logic out.

a11_0012800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0012800.text: Wow, I hope they get that. That's pretty.

a11_0012800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0012800.text: With the Sun glaring like it is, you're - you're correct on the f:22, I'm sure. It might be part of the...

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Okay. We're - we're ready to - for the hot fire check when you're ready.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Roger. We're ready 11. Go ahead.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Roger. Here's the pitch. [Long pause.]

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: 11, this is Houston. We're seeing the pitch hot firing and it looks good.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Roger. Be advised that we are unable to hear 'em.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Roger. We copy.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Have you seen all three axes fire?

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: We've seen pitch and yaw; we've not seen roll to date.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Okay. I'll put in a couple more rolls.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Okay. We've got the roll impulses, and you're looking good here.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Roger.

a11_0014133.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0014133.text: Houston, Apollo 11. We're standing by for a Go for sequence logic On.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Go ahead and we'll watch you on TM.

a11_0014133.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0014133.text: Okay. Sequence logic, two of them. [Pause.] Sequence logic 1 and 2 coming up and On.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for Pyro Arm.

a11_0014133.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0014133.text: Roger. Thank you.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. If you can give us P00 and Accept, we have a state vector update for you.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: Roger.

a11_0014133.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0014133.text: You have P00 and Accept.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Roger. It will probably be another 10 or 15 seconds. We're going to go up through the Vanguard. When you're ready to copy, I have your TLI PAD.

a11_0014133.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014133.text: Roger. TLI: 2:35:14; 179, 071, 001, burn time 5:47, 10435.6, 35575. Roll for Sep 357, 107, 041; 301, 287, 319. TLI 10-minute abort pitch, 223. Readback. Over.

a11_0014706.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014706.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. We've completed the uplink; the computer is yours. You can go back to Block. And would you verify that you have extended the probe? Over.

a11_0014706.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0014706.text: Roger. That's verified. The probe is extended.

a11_0014706.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014706.text: Roger. About 2 minutes to LOS on this state-side pass. AOS Canaries at 1:50:13. Over.

a11_0014706.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0014706.text: This is Apollo Control. The tracking ship, Vanguard, has had Loss Of Signal. However, the Canary Island station will acquire Apollo 11 in less than a minute. We'll continue to stay up live through the Canary station. The ignition time for the Translunar Injection burn; an elapsed time of 2 hours, 44 minutes, 14 seconds. Duration of the burn expected to be 5 minutes, 47 seconds. We're acquiring at Canaries now. We'll stand by.

a11_0014706.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0014706.text: Roger. Houston, Apollo 11. Loud and clear.

a11_0014706.speaker: McCandless
a11_0014706.text: Okay. On your Service Module RCS quad Bravo package temperature, we're showing it running a little low. Looks like about 20 degrees low - lower than the rest of the quads. Would you confirm that your RCS heater switch for quad Bravo is in Primary? Over.

a11_t-0015055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0015055.text: You're correct. It was not in Primary. It was off. It's on now. Thank you.

a11_t-0015055.speaker: Mission Control
a11_t-0015055.text: And the temperature on that Reaction Control System quad is coming up to normal now that the heater's on.

a11_0015350.speaker: McCandless
a11_0015350.text: Roger. We've checked over the spacecraft and the launch vehicle guidance. They're both looking to be in good shape. We estimate you have better than a 99-percent probability of a guidance cut-off on the launch vehicle, so things are apparently holding in very well. For your information, MILA received approximately 1 minute of a usable TV picture, so apparently the system is working. And you're a little over a minute from LOS at Canary. AOS Tananarive is 2 hours, 9 minutes and 18 seconds. Over.

a11_0015350.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015350.text: Roger. We like those 99 numbers. Thank you.

a11_0015350.speaker: Collins
a11_0015350.text: Now, let's see. We want to go to the suit circuit...

a11_0015500.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0015500.text: Ready for EDS Power, On, you think?

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: EDS Power, up and On, yes.

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: EMS Function, Delta-V; set range VHF A.

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: Then go to Normal. Anybody know what we're doing with Verb 48 up there?

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: What are we supposed to be putting in there?

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: I wonder what the hell that is?

a11_0015500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0015500.text: Just verify you got a 3 there?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: Okay.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: You can't have that.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: You don't want that one, do you?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: No.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: Trade it - for a good one.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: How about some LM pointing angles?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: Okay, let's do one more. We're going first opportunity, you think?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0020055.text: Burn time is 5 plus 47.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: Uh huh.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0020055.text: And the emergency shutdown, Neil, is plus 10 seconds; 10 minus 40 on the Delta-V C , is that right?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: Plus 6 seconds, plus 6.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: And - no - no, I'm sure about that minus.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: No, no, it's not; it's only [garble].

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: No, it's plus 6 seconds and V I on the DSKY at G&N.

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0020055.text: I think that's going to show up here, isn't it?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0020055.text: What?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0020055.text: TLI?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: The roll?

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0020055.text: Burn [garble].

a11_t-0020055.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0020055.text: They're in the damn Flight Plan; I don't think they're in the checklist.

a11_0020800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0020800.text: Should be about 100 [garble] - okay...

a11_0020800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0020800.text: Water - boiling - [garble] potable. Okay.

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Fuel cells [garble] fuel cells making water. It goes to potable tank first and then the waste tank.

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Oh - stop there?

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Yes.

a11_0020800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0020800.text: Coming into the terminator.

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Gee, I'm really disappointed over those optics; that telescope is horrible. Maybe it'll get better with practice, or adaptation, or what have you.

a11_0020800.speaker: McCandless
a11_0020800.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston through Tananarive. How do you read? [No answer. Long pause.]

a11_0020800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0020800.text: Gee, I almost went to sleep here.

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Me, too. I'm taking a little rest.

a11_0020800.speaker: McCandless
a11_0020800.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston standing by through Tananarive. [No answer.]

a11_0020800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0020800.text: It's going to be a long day.

a11_0020800.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0020800.text: How'd the - is this the first part of the attitude comparison check or the second part?

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Tananarive, Houston Comm Tech Net 1.

a11_0020800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0020800.text: I haven't done the second GDC align yet; it comes up on the next page. About now, I guess.

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Tananarive, Houston Comm Tech Net 1.

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Goddard voice, Houston Comm Tech Net 1.

a11_0020800.speaker: Collins
a11_0020800.text: Well, we should have Tananarive. How about going - pressing ahead with the sequence pyro arm?

a11_0020800.speaker: MSFN
a11_0020800.text: Goddard: Voice, reading you loud and clear.

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Roger. We cannot raise Tananarive.

a11_0020800.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0020800.text: Okay, let me align the GDC.

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Houston Comm Tech, Tananarive.

a11_0020800.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_0020800.text: Roger, Tananarive. Are you receiving CapCom's voice, and are you uplinking it?

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Comm Tech
a11_t-0021035.text: Roger. Monitor this - Monitor again and I'll have CapCom make one more transmission.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0021035.text: Well, they cleverly do this on, just on opposite sides of the world so you always have to pitch - run all the thumbwheels the maximum amount.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0021035.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston standing by through Tananarive. Over.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: McCandless
a11_t-0021035.text: Roger. Reading you loud and clear.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0021035.text: No, I haven't. Just a second, I'll be right with you.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0021035.text: Looks like the setting on the Auto thing is such that it just runs a little cold.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0021035.text: Yes, that's right. That's - that's what I think, too.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Collins
a11_t-0021035.text: [Garble] have a feeling I have a ball in here.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Armstrong
a11_t-0021035.text: Okay, the GDC is - is aligned. Ready to proceed.

a11_t-0021035.speaker: Aldrin
a11_t-0021035.text: Okay. We've got the Verb 48 in, Verb 83, ORDEAL set, and Sequence Pyro Arm.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Houston, Apollo 11. We have the Pyros armed.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Okay.

a11_0021235.speaker: McCandless
a11_0021235.text: This is Houston. Roger. Out.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Trans Control Power's On. Rot Control Power, Normal, two, AC/DC.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: They're all up.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Direct? Main A, Main B.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Direct.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: S-II/S-IVB.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Check.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Guidance, IU?

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: IU, yes.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Circuit breakers, Direct Ullage, two, closed.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Okay.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: And the event timer's set.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Now, why don't you - why don't you put ORDEAL on 200/Lunar?

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Alright.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Maybe you can start figuring out what the hell that ought to be.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: I guess leave them on Inertial for the time being.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Beyond my ability to compute here right now.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: [Garble]?

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: You're not worried now on that thing?

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: When the motor lights up, he's worried.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: [Garble] 190, 110 degrees.

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: Got a long way around, yet.

a11_0021235.speaker: McCandless
a11_0021235.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. One minute to LOS Tananarive. AOS at Carnarvon 2:25:30.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Roger.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: Uh huh, 02:25:30. [Garble].

a11_0021235.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0021235.text: This is Apollo Control at 2 hours, 16 minutes. Tananarive has Loss of Signal. The Carnarvon station will acquire at 2 hours, 25½ minutes. During the Carnarvon pass, the Go/No Go decision will be made for the Translunar Injection maneuver. That maneuver to occur at about 27 minutes from now, near the - the spacecraft is near the Gilbert Islands, about halfway between Australia and Hawaii. We'll come back up just prior to Carnarvon acquisition. This is Mission Control, Houston.

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: Why did they do that? That should be up here, before 2:35.

a11_0021235.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0021235.text: I don't know. It's screwed up in here anyway.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Well, weren't they giving us two abort PADs before?

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: No, TLI plus 90 and TLI plus 4 hours. And now the TLI plus 4 hours is TLI plus 5 hours, P37.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Oh, is that right?

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: Uh huh. Got them on the same page.

a11_0021235.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0021235.text: Yeah, they're on the same page.

a11_0021235.speaker: Collins
a11_0021235.text: Yeah, I was expecting them to get something in.

a11_0022500.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0022500.text: This is Apollo Control at 2 hours, 25 minutes; and Carnarvon has acquired Apollo 11. At LOS here at Carnarvon, we will have several ARIAs, Apollo Range Instrumented Aircraft, in the area between LOS Carnarvon and acquisition at the tracking ship Redstone, so we may have the capability of continuous communications between now and the TLI burn. We'll stand by through Carnarvon.

a11_0022500.speaker: McCandless
a11_0022500.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston through Carnarvon. Radio check. Over.

a11_0022500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0022500.text: Roger, Houston through Carnarvon. Apollo 11. Loud and clear.

a11_0022500.speaker: McCandless
a11_0022500.text: Roger. You're coming in very loud and very clear, here. Out.

a11_0022500.speaker: McCandless
a11_0022500.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go for TLI. Over.

a11_0023011.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023011.text: Roger. We'll be coming within range of the ARIA aircraft coverage, here, in about one minute. They're going to try uplinking both on S-band and on VHF this time. So if you turn your - make sure your S-band volume is turned up, we'd appreciate it. And we believe that we'll have continuous coverage from now on through the TLI burn. Over.

a11_0023011.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023011.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston through ARIA 4. Radio check. Over.

a11_0023011.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0023011.text: Houston, we read you strength 4 and a little scratchy.

a11_0023011.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023011.text: Roger. We're reading you strength 5, readability about 3. Should be quite adequate.

a11_0023011.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0023011.text: Roger. We've got a little static in the background now.

a11_0023011.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023011.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. We're reading you readability about 3, strength 5. Sounds pretty good. Over.

a11_0023721.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023721.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston through ARIA 3. Radio check. Over.

a11_0023721.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0023721.text: Roger, Houston, Apollo 11. You are much clearer and adequately loud. Over.

a11_0023721.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023721.text: Roger, 11, You are coming in five-by-five here. Beautiful signal.

a11_0023721.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0023721.text: This is a lot better than this static we had previously.

a11_0023721.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0023721.text: And we got the timebase fix indication on time.

a11_0023721.speaker: McCandless
a11_0023721.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. We just got telemetry back on your booster, and it's looking good.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. We just got telemetry back on your booster, and it's looking good.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Roger. Everything looks good here.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Houston, Roger. Out.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: This is Apollo Control. We're 2 minutes from ignition now.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Slightly less than one minute to ignition, and everything is Go.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Okay, 59:25. And this light will go off at 42.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Time is based on tracking data. Let me know when you start it up.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Okay.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: When you feel it, that's when it is.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Okay, this light is out - know any of it any more.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Okay, we're operate - 59:59.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: There we go; thrust.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Ignition! Call it at 15.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Ignition. [Pause.]

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Okay.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Whew!

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: We confirm ignition, and the thrust is Go. [Long pause.]

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Pressures look good.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Flashes out window number 5.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: I'm not sure whether that's - it could be lightning, or it could be something to do with the engine.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Continual flashes [garble].

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: About 2 degrees off in the pitch [garble].

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Yeah, wouldn't worry too much about that.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston at 1 minute. Trajectory and guidance look good, and the stage is good. Over.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11. Rog.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: Coming up on 27,000 feet per second.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Don't look out window 1. If you're - if it looks like what I see out window 5, you don't want to look at it [Laughter].

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: I don't see anything.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Why?

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: These flashes out here...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Oh, I see a little flashing out there, yes.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: You see that? Buzz is usually looking - just watch window 5 for a second. See it?

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Yes, yes. Damn, everything's - just kind of sparks flying out there.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Yes, that's - Oopsedo.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Man, that really...

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: That's PU shift?

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: I don't know, but it sure put a little blip in there at 2 minutes. I think it increased in thrust.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Think it's the PU shift?

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Thrust is good. Everything's still looking good.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Roger.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: That's about like a pitch change rather than an acceleration increase. Did it feel that way to you?

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Okay. We got a lighted horizon at 2½ minutes. Pretty horizon.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: We're 2½ minutes into this burn. Still have another three minutes to go.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: A fairly smooth ride, you know. It's just a little tiny bit rattly, but nothing like Stafford's. H-dot looks great. Don't bet you could do any better.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: I'm sure I couldn't. I'd do worse because I'd be a - a full degree off from where it is right now.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: And velocity exceeds 29,000 feet per second, building up toward 30,000 feet per second.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Don't sweat that. 3 minutes.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: 3 minutes. What we got, about one g, Neil?

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Pressures are good...

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Yes, we've got 3 feet per second...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Just under one g.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Mike, we're within 3 feet per second on the card H-dot.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Fantastic. And it's shaking everything a little bit.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Shaking at 3 minutes.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Okay.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: I hope that camera doesn't fall on your face.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: I checked it; it's locked in there pretty well. Won't hurt this visor...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: 03:30 coming up. Should be 5.5, and it is 5.5.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Nice ride.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Around 3½ minutes, you're still looking good. Your predicted cut-off is right on the nominal.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Roger. Apollo 11's Go.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: 31,200 feet per second now. Altitude 125 nautical miles.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: I see a bright star out there, must be Venus. Forgot to memorize John Mayer's views out the window well enough to say that's Venus or not, but it's sure bright.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: What would you do about it?

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Nothing.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Four minutes...

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Tell you what, that's Venus.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: 10 feet per second off on H-dot...

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: [Garble], that's about where it is.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Here comes the old Sun.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Gee, that's going to be bright.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Glad I got my card up.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: I'm glad you had - you do too, Neil. That was a good idea, a hell of a good idea. I can't see - well, my tapes are [garble] I can't [garble] see very much.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: One minute left to burn. Velocity's 33,000 feet per second. Altitude 142½ nautical miles.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Coming up on 04:30. How you look, Buzz?

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Looks good. Oh, about 14 feet per second right now. The altitude's very good. We ought to get a real good 5-minute cut at the [garble].

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: You guys agree with my mark; we'll be 5 minutes?

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Okay.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Just a second.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Five minutes.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Mark.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go at 5 minutes.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Roger. We're Go.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: 34,000 feet per second now. Altitude 152.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Okay, we're just a little bit low on time.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Right on it.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: [Garble] yaw.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: [Garble] do that?

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Yeah, we better do that.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: 5 - 5 seconds...

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: What kind of g we pulling?

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: We got a g 1.2 or 3. 1.3, maybe.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Gee, feels a lot more than that already.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: 35,000 feet per second.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Okay, 6 - okay, about 5 seconds to nominal.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Here we go...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: We have cut-off.

a11_0024020.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0024020.text: Cut-off. We're showing velocity 35,570 feet per second. Altitude 177 nautical miles.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: 3.3 on the Delta...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: The Delta-V C on the EMS: 3.3.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Beautiful. EMS Function, Off.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Off.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: SECS Pyro Arm, two, Safe.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: I got out - I got out of kilter here. Let's go back and let Buzz pick up on it. You're just a little bit ahead of yourself on the checklist.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Okay.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Okay, Houston, you read 11?

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Buzz, forget I read anything in the checklist.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. We show cut-off and we copy the numbers in Noun 62. [No answer. Long pause.]

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Yeah...

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Not getting any answer...

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Okay, let's go to IU Accept here. Now [garble].

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, Houston. Do you read? [No answer. Long pause.]

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: Why don't you try to get up high?

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: SCS TVC Servo Power 1, Off.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Okay. You want to get Houston on the radio if you can?

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Yeah.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: PCM Bit Rate, Low.

a11_0024020.speaker: Collins
a11_0024020.text: PCM Bit Rate is Low...

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Do you read? Over.

a11_0024020.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024020.text: Roger, Houston. Apollo 11. We're reading a V I of 35579 and the EMS was plus 3.3. Over.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Roger. Plus 3.3 on the EMS. And we copy the V I .

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: Hey, Houston, Apollo 11. That Saturn gave us a magnificent ride.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Roger, 11. We'll pass that on. And, it certainly looks like you are well on your way now.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: We got - We have no complaints with any of the three stages on that ride. It was beautiful.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Roger. We copy. No transients at staging of any significance? Over.

a11_0024020.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024020.text: That's right. It was all - all a good ride.

a11_0024020.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024020.text: Houston. Roger. Out. [Long pause.]

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Slightly less than one minute to ignition, and everything is Go.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay, 59:25. And this light will go off at 42.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Time is based on tracking data. Let me know when you start it up.

a11_0024318ob.text: When you feel it, that's when it is.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay, this light is out - know any of it any more.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: We confirm ignition, and the thrust is Go. [Long pause.]

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: I'm not sure whether that's - it could be lightning, or it could be something to do with the engine.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: About 2 degrees off in the pitch [garble].

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Yeah, wouldn't worry too much about that.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston at 1 minute. Trajectory and guidance look good, and the stage is good. Over.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Don't look out window 1. If you're - if it looks like what I see out window 5, you don't want to look at it [Laughter].

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Oh, I see a little flashing out there, yes.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: You see that? Buzz is usually looking - just watch window 5 for a second. See it?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Yes, yes. Damn, everything's - just kind of sparks flying out there.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: I don't know, but it sure put a little blip in there at 2 minutes. I think it increased in thrust.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Thrust is good. Everything's still looking good.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: That's about like a pitch change rather than an acceleration increase. Did it feel that way to you?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay. We got a lighted horizon at 2½ minutes. Pretty horizon.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: A fairly smooth ride, you know. It's just a little tiny bit rattly, but nothing like Stafford's. H-dot looks great. Don't bet you could do any better.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: I'm sure I couldn't. I'd do worse because I'd be a - a full degree off from where it is right now.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: 3 minutes. What we got, about one g, Neil?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Yes, we've got 3 feet per second...

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Mike, we're within 3 feet per second on the card H-dot.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Fantastic. And it's shaking everything a little bit.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: I hope that camera doesn't fall on your face.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: I checked it; it's locked in there pretty well. Won't hurt this visor...

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: 03:30 coming up. Should be 5.5, and it is 5.5.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Around 3½ minutes, you're still looking good. Your predicted cut-off is right on the nominal.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: I see a bright star out there, must be Venus. Forgot to memorize John Mayer's views out the window well enough to say that's Venus or not, but it's sure bright.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: What would you do about it?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: 10 feet per second off on H-dot...

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Gee, that's going to be bright.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Glad I got my card up.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: I'm glad you had - you do too, Neil. That was a good idea, a hell of a good idea. I can't see - well, my tapes are [garble] I can't [garble] see very much.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Coming up on 04:30. How you look, Buzz?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Looks good. Oh, about 14 feet per second right now. The altitude's very good. We ought to get a real good 5-minute cut at the [garble].

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: You guys agree with my mark; we'll be 5 minutes?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0024318ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You are Go at 5 minutes.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay, we're just a little bit low on time.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: What kind of g we pulling?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: We got a g 1.2 or 3. 1.3, maybe.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Gee, feels a lot more than that already.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay, 6 - okay, about 5 seconds to nominal.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: The Delta-V C on the EMS: 3.3.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: I got out - I got out of kilter here. Let's go back and let Buzz pick up on it. You're just a little bit ahead of yourself on the checklist.

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0024318ob.text: Buzz, forget I read anything in the checklist.

a11_0024318ob.text: Okay, let's go to IU Accept here. Now [garble].

a11_0024318ob.text: Why don't you try to get up high?

a11_0024318ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0024318ob.text: Okay. You want to get Houston on the radio if you can?

a11_0025409.speaker: McCandless
a11_0025409.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. For your information, we expect the maneuver to separation attitude to begin at 3 plus 05 plus 03, and to be completed at plus 09 plus 20. Separation at 3 plus 15 plus 00.

a11_0025409.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0025409.text: Roger. Time to begin maneuver is 3:05:03, complete 3:09:20. And separation 3 plus 15:00.

a11_0025409.speaker: McCandless
a11_0025409.text: Roger. That separation should be 3 plus 15:03. My error in reading up.

a11_0025409.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0025409.text: This is Apollo Control. The velocity falling off now immediately after shutdown. We're showing 34,000 feet per second [10,400 m/s] now, but the altitude building; 512 nautical miles [948 km].

a11_0025409.speaker: McCandless
a11_0025409.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. All the booster functions are proceeding normally. The sequencing is in good shape, and it doesn't look like they're having any problems at all. Over.

a11_0030528.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030528.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Our preliminary data indicates a good cut-off on the S-IVB. We'll have some more trajectory data for you in about half an hour. Over.

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: This is Apollo Control. The S-IVB has started its maneuvering to the separation attitude.

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: At 3 hours, 7 minutes, the velocity is 27,945 feet per second [8,518 m/s]. Distance from Earth, 2,384 nautical miles [4,415 km].

a11_0030528.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030528.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Over. [No answer.]

a11_0030528.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030528.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Over. [Long pause.]

a11_0030528.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0030528.text: Hello, Houston. Hello, Houston. This is Apollo 11. I'm reading you loud and clear. Go ahead. Over.

a11_0030528.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030528.text: Roger, 11. This is Houston. We had to shift stations. We weren't reading you through Goldstone. We show Pyro Bus A armed and Pyro Bus B not armed at the present time. Over.

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: The S-IVB has completed its maneuver to separation attitude.

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: At 3 hours, 11 minutes into the mission; velocity, 26,314 feet per second [8,021 m/s]. Distance from Earth, 3,140 nautical miles [5,815 km].

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: The S-IVB is reported in a stable attitude for the separation.

a11_0030528.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030528.text: Rates are less than 1/10th of a foot per second in all axes.

a11_0030901.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030901.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Over. [No answer.]

a11_0030901.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030901.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Over. [Long pause.]

a11_0030901.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0030901.text: Hello, Houston. Hello, Houston. This is Apollo 11. I'm reading you loud and clear. Go ahead. Over.

a11_0030901.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030901.text: Roger, 11. This is Houston. We had to shift stations. We weren't reading you through Goldstone. We show Pyro Bus A armed and Pyro Bus B not armed at the present time. Over.

a11_0030901.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030901.text: The S-IVB has completed its maneuver to separation attitude.

a11_0030901.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0030901.text: The S-IVB is reported in a stable attitude for the separation.

a11_0030901.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030901.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. You're Go for separation. Our systems recommendation is arm both Pyro Buses. Over.

a11_0030901.speaker: Collins
a11_0030901.text: Okay. Pyro B coming armed. My intent is to use bottle Primary 1, as per the checklist; therefore, I just turned A on.

a11_0030901.speaker: McCandless
a11_0030901.text: Roger. We concur with the logic.

a11_0031627.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627.text: And we're going to translate plus X and hold.

a11_0031627.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627.text: Watch the tank pressure and the engine light.

a11_0031627.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627.text: Are you on tank pressures? You are.

a11_0031627.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627.text: And you're going to go to 100.8?

a11_0031627.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0031627.text: Okay, Houston, we're about to Sep.

a11_0031627.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627.text: Okay, got 0.7; I'm going to stop there and...

a11_0031627.speaker: Aldrin

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: Yeah, I know; those numbers don't mean anything. They were 99-something when we turned around; don't ask me why. I thrusted toward him quite a bit, and I don't know why those numbers were screwed up, but they were.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0031627ob.text: Buzz, how does he look to you; looks like he's getting closer to me.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Armstrong

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: Flies like a spacecraft instead of a simulator. Hope that's good.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: Sure beautiful. I hope you got some pictures, Buzz.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0031627ob.text: It really looks nice, doesn't it?

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: Hey, we're closing in a leisurely fashion.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins

a11_0031627ob.text: I don't care [garble] tell by looking at [garble].

a11_0031627ob.text: The thing is, with this sitting there, I can't get much with the Hasselblad. That window's no good, I'm afraid.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: Yeah, you might look - if you're looking for something to do, you might just look over my panel 1 and 8 and all that and make sure all the switches are - to your liking.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: McCandless
a11_0031627ob.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Radio check. Over.[No answer.]

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0031627ob.text: The Goldstone station reports a very weak signal. We believe that Mike Collins is now maneuvering the spacecraft in the transposition and docking maneuver, and the antenna patterns aren't too good at the moment, so we have a weak signal strength.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0031627ob.text: Be sure that your RCS is working anyway.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627ob.text: How far out are you, Mike?

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Collins
a11_0031627ob.text: I'm still quite a ways. That's definitely an SLA panel - there's no doubt about that. Sure looks like [garble] panel. That stuff's hitting from the S-IVB from us. Geeze, look it - that one thing just hit the - gyro package on the S-band antenna.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627ob.text: Yes, things occasionally come scooting out.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627ob.text: And, occasionally, you know, a little piece of something hits the - what do you call that - covering? The whole LM quivers every so often. All - all the surface of it, Neil, you know, just kind of shakes like that.

a11_0031627ob.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0031627ob.text: Just in one spot; it's not being hit. I hope it doesn't come in [garble]...

a11_0032207.text: Just from the APS firing, you think?

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston broadcasting in the blind. Request Omni Bravo if you read us. Request Omni Bravo. Out. [No answer.]

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. How do you read? [No answer.]

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Okay...

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: We don't have too much...

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: ...BMAG Mode, three - You should stabilize and align CM - BMAG Mode, three, to Att 1/Rate 2?

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Okay.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: And we're - translated plus X. That Capture Probe, Extend/Release, you've done that; CMC Mode, Free?

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: Yes, sir.

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Yes.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Allow probe to damp spacecraft oscillations?

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: We did that.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Yes, you've done that. Docking Probe, Retract, Primary 1?

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: We did that.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Alright, after dock...

a11_0032207.text: Docking Probe, Extend/Release, to Off?

a11_0032207.text: Yes.

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: Okay.

a11_0032207.text: Alright, let's go. Docking Probe, Retract, two of them, Off?

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong/Collins
a11_0032207.text: Yes, they're Off.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Alright. Circuit breakers: Docking Probe, two, Open.

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Okay, PCM Bit Rate is Low. Post-docking: it says Rate, High; Att Deadband, Max.

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. How do you read? Over. [No answer.]

a11_0032207.text: COAS Power, Off.

a11_0032207.text: How do the - Speaking of that, how do the Service Module RCS quantities look?

a11_0032207.text: No, C and D are [garble] B, anyway.

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Do you read? Over. [No answer.]

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: Okay...

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Well, I got to go in there and dick...

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: I'm not sure that we're getting...

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: Well, Buzz is getting comm right now.

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Yes, let Buzz do his High-Gain thing, and I'll get ready to go dick with the tunnel.

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Sure is squiggly, isn't it? It really wanders all over, doesn't it?

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Neil, where do you put this guy - usually?

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: I - clip it to that - clip up there beside the COAS - you see...

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Okay.

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: ...see those clips up there, one of those. It's got a snap right here that's pretty good.

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: I think I can get it now - [garble].

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Radio check. Over. [No answer.]

a11_0032207.speaker: Collins
a11_0032207.text: Okay, Buzz, how am I doing on the checklist?

a11_0032207.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032207.text: Apollo 11, Apollo 11, this is Houston. Radio check. Over. [No answer.]

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: Well, I'm trying to...

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: You're at the High Gain...

a11_0032207.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032207.text: ...you're at post-docking. I'm trying to get the High Gain going - and I'm having a little trouble - [garble] trouble.

a11_0032207.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032207.text: That's Manual...

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Radio check. Over.

a11_0032920.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032920.text: [Very faint] Roger. Loud and clear.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Roger. We're copying you about five-by-two, very weak. Can you give us a status report, please?

a11_0032920.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032920.text: Roger. We are docked. We do have acquisition with the High Gain at this time, I think.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Understand you are using the High Gain. Over.

a11_0032920.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032920.text: That's affirmative.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Roger. I read - I read you very loud and clear, Buzz. Mike's pretty weak.

a11_0032920.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032920.text: Roger. We've got the High Gain locked on, now, I believe; Auto tracking now.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Okay. You're coming in loud and clear, but Mike is just barely readable.

a11_0032920.speaker: Collins
a11_0032920.text: That was Neil. How are you reading Mike?

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Loud and clear now, Mike, and we understand that you are docked.

a11_0032920.speaker: Collins
a11_0032920.text: That's affirmative. [Pause]

a11_0032920.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032920.text: Houston, CDR. How do you read [garble]?

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: 11, CDR, loud and clear, Neil.

a11_0032920.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0032920.text: Okay.

a11_0032920.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0032920.text: This is Apollo Control. Apollo 11's velocity now 21,096 feet per second [6,430 m/s]. Distance from Earth, 6,649 nautical miles [12,314 km].

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: 11, this is Houston. Over.

a11_0032920.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032920.text: Houston, Apollo 11. Go ahead.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Roger. When you commented on quad Bravo problem at separation, you were a little weak. Could you go through what you did after you noticed the talkback's barber pole again, please?

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: We copied the - the primary and secondary propellant talkbacks on SM RCS quad Bravo 1 to barber pole on separation.

a11_0032920.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0032920.text: Roger. Roger. That is affirmative, and we moved that switch to the Open position and they went back to gray. Over.

a11_0032920.speaker: McCandless
a11_0032920.text: Roger.

a11_0033751.speaker: McCandless
a11_0033751.text: Roger. Could you give us some comments on how the transposition and docking went? Over.

a11_0033751.speaker: Collins
a11_0033751.text: I thought it went pretty well, Houston, although I expect I used more gas than I've been using in the simulator. The turnaround maneuver - I went Pitch, Accel Command and started to pitch up, and then when I put the Manual Attitude, Pitch back to Rate Command, for some reason it - it stopped its pitch rate, and I had to go back to Accel Command and hit what I thought was an extra Proceed on the DSKY. Then, during the course of that, we drifted slightly further away from the S-IVB than I expected. I expected to be out about 66 feet. My guess would be I was around 100 or so; and therefore, I exp

a11_0033751.speaker: McCandless
a11_0033751.text: This is Houston. Roger. We copy.

a11_0033751.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0033751.text: That was Mike Collins giving the description on the transposition and docking.

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Houston, Apollo 11. Over.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Go ahead, 11.

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Rog. We're working on the pressurization of the LM now, and working off the decal with CSM-LM pressure equalization. And we're down to step 13, where we're waiting for the cabin pressure to be 5, or it should be roughly 5 [psi, 34 kPa], before we turn the Repress package O 2 valve to Fill. Instead of 5, we're running about 4.4. Over.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Roger. Stand by a second. [Long pause.]

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: And Houston, Apollo 11. We did put the Repress package O 2 valve to Fill momentarily there at step 13, and we have filled the bottles back up partially. What's the pressure reading there now, Neil?

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: We have about 450 psi [3.1 MPa] now in the - in the three 1-pound bottles.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Roger. Stand by a second, please.

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Roger. Standing by. And the Repress package valve is now in the Off position. What's the cabin pressure now, Buzz? Cabin pressure's now 4.5. [Long pause.]

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Houston, Apollo 11. We think these readings are within normal tolerances. We just wanted to get your concurrence before we press down any further with these decals.

a11_0034345.speaker: MCC Speaker
a11_0034345.text: Okay, CapCom. [Long pause.]

a11_0034345.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0034345.text: Houston, Apollo 11. How do you read?

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Apollo 11, this is Houston. Go ahead.

a11_0034345.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0034345.text: Rog. LM looks to be in pretty fine shape. About all we can see from here.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Okay. In reference to your question on this step 13 on the decal, I understand that you have used up the contents of the Repress O 2 package and at that time, instead of being up to 5 psi, you were reading 4.4. Is that correct?

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Okay. 4.4. Yes sir.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Okay. And you want to know if you can go ahead and use additional oxygen to bring the Command Module up to 5.0 and continue the equalization? Over.

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
a11_0034345.text: Yes. We think it's within normal tolerances, Bruce. We just wanted to get your concurrence before we press on with this procedure.

a11_0034345.speaker: McCandless
a11_0034345.text: Roger, Apollo 11. Go ahead.

a11_0034345.speaker: Collins
