a11_0982500.text: Roger. Eagle's in Voice mode. How do you read? Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Roger. You're about three-by now, Buzz. We're satisfied with this configuration. Let's stay where we are. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: Houston, Columbia's in Omni C, Charlie, Down Voice Backup and, when you get a chance, could you look up the coordinates of 130 for me, please? I have conflicting information between my cue card and my Flight Plan. I'd like to know which coordinates you want me to use.

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Roger. Stand by. [Long pause.]

a11_0982500.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0982500.text: Houston, Eagle. Completed gear extension okay. [Long pause.]

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Columbia, Houston. We're satisfied with what you already have loaded in P22 for these coordinates. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: Thank you, Houston.

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Columbia, Houston. The coordinates you have loaded in P22 are - we have - are Site 130 prime. Do you concur? Over. [Pause.]

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: I have the coordinates loaded off the cue card which is - for crater 130. [Long pause.]

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Columbia, Houston. We made an error on those coordinates. We'd like you to load for latitude in a Noun 89, plus 01243; longitude over 2, plus 11844; altitude, minus 00146 as shown in the Flight Plan. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: Okay. Thank you.

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Eagle, Houston. Could you give us an idea where you are in the activation? Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0982500.text: Rog. We're just sitting around waiting for something to do. We need a state vector, a REFSMMAT before we can proceed on with the AGS, and we need you to watch our DAP data load, gimbal drive check, and throttle test. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Roger. Eagle, we'll have the state vectors and the REFSMMAT for you as soon as we get the High Gain. Over. It will be about another 10 minutes or so before we get through the P22, and when we maneuver to attitude and get the High Gain, we'll have the updates for you. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0982500.text: Roger. We'll go ahead with the DAP and the throttle check since we don't have a gimbal drive test, okay?

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Rog. Understand you're going to the DAP throttle - That's affirmative.

a11_0982500.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0982500.text: This is Apollo Control. We'll continue to have rather noisy communications from the spacecraft until the orbital navigation is completed. Mike Collins is preparing to take marks on a landmark near the prime landing site. This information will be received here in Mission Control and will be used to update the ground's knowledge of where the spacecraft is, and in turn that information will assist in setting the precise time for the powered descent. Once the orbital navigation is completed, we'll be able to get a High Gain Antenna and LM steerable antenna locked on and we should see some improvem

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: Houston, Columbia. Those T1 and T2 times are still good, aren't they?

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: Say again. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: I say, the T1 and T2 times remain unchanged, affirmative?

a11_0982500.speaker: Duke
a11_0982500.text: That's affirmative. Over.

a11_0982500.speaker: Collins
a11_0982500.text: Thank you.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Eagle.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Go ahead, Eagle. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Rog. In accordance with the - on page 47, step 1, we had the guidance control in PGNS and Mode Control, PGNS, Auto. And, of course, the circuit breakers are not in on the thrusters yet, so when we started through the DAP and proceeded on Noun 46 - and we're looking at Noun 47 now - why, we got an RCS TCA light, and we've got four out of the eight other bright-colored red flags. I think that this is explained by the fact that we are in - PGNS and Auto and just unable to fire the thrusters. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Stand by. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. You are correct. The lights are there and the flags because we haven't closed the breakers yet. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: And Houston, Eagle. Are you going to need the High Gain before you can look at our GDA position indicator?

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Stand by. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. We can see all the throttle data...

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: I can give high...

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Go ahead. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: I could give you high bit rate on the Omnis if that will help any.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Negative. We have all the throttle data we need. You can stay low bit rate. You can proceed through the throttle test, but do not do the gimbal trim. Over. Repeat, do not do the gimbal trim.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Understand. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Boy, you just can't miss those check points, Diamondback and Sidewinder. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Auto optics are pointed just a little bit north of crater 130.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Copy, Columbia. Out.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: [Garble].

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Eagle. We're ready to pressurize the RCS. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Stand by. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. You can go ahead with your RCS pressurization, but we would like to hold off on the RCS check-out until we get the high bit rate. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Roger.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: And Eagle, Houston. Have you deployed the landing gear yet? Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: That's affirmative. The landing gear is out and gray.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Columbia. I've completed my marks. I've gone Accel Command in all three axes to prevent that thruster firing that last time.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0983758.text: Mike Collins reporting that he has completed the marks for landmark tracking. We also got a report from the LM that they have deployed the landing gear, and that report came at 98 hours, 45 minutes.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Columbia. As soon as you have the necessary data on the downlink, let me know and I'll proceed.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Columbia, stand by on the Noun 49. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Standing by, Houston. No rush. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: I will.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Columbia, Houston. We got the Noun 49. You can proceed. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Rog. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Colum - correction, Eagle, Houston. We see the Master Arm, you can go ahead and press. We see the press now. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Looks good.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger, Buzz. If you've got - would like, I've got your AGS abort constants. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Ready to copy.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. For your AGS address 224, plus 60267; 225, plus 58148; 226, plus 70312; 227, minus 50031. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Good read-back. Out. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Columbia. My P22 is complete. I'm continuing this maneuver to AGS CAL attitude.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Fine. We copy.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Roger.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Columbia. Your High Gain angles are - Corrected - Eagle, Houston. Your High Gain angles are 165 pitch, yaw 66. Over. [Pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: [Very weak on air-ground] Roger. Columbia, Eagle. Have you about maneuvered there, yet?

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Roger.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Negative.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: [Inaudible on air-ground] Houston, Eagle. Are those angles for after the maneuver that Columbia is going to make or are they for right now? Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: We have about another 120 degrees to go, Buzz.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: [Inaudible on air-ground] Stand by about another...

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Eagle. I believe I've got you on the High Gain Antenna now in high bit rate. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Columbia, Houston. If you go to Reacq on the High Gain, we can acquire you now. Over. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. We got some loads for you if you'll give us P00 and Data. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: You've got P00 and Data.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Rog. We've got both of you on the High Gains now. It sounds great now. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Columbia.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Columbia. Rog.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Columbia, Houston. I have a SEP PAD if you're ready to copy. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Stand by one. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Ready to copy.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger, Mike. SEP PAD, RCS/G&N: Noun 47 and Noun 48 are NA; Noun 33, 100:39:50.00; Noun 81 is NA. Roll; 000, 007, 000. Rest of PAD is NA.

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: SEP, RCS/G&N at a T IG of 100:39:50, roll 0, pitch 007, yaw 0. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Good readback. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Eagle. Are you ready for us to start the RCS check-out now?

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: As soon as we finish the uplink. Stand by one. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Collins
a11_0983758.text: Houston, Columbia. Comment on P22. It worked just fine. The target I marked on is a small crater down inside crater 130, as described by John Young.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Rog. We copy. [Pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. On our load - during our load, we had to do a Verb 96 to stop integration. We're going to start over again on this load. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Eagle. Rog.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: And, Eagle, here. I have read out address out of the AGS, 404, 405 and 406, and I had believed that 405 and 406 would both be all zeros, and I would propose maybe that I reset them to zero. I realize that 404 should be a negative number, and it is minus 13495. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Roger. Copy. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Go ahead.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Buzz, we've got - The only thing we're missing here is the drift check. After we finish our load, we'd like you to do the drift check with Columbia. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0983758.text: Go. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. The 404, 405, 406 look fine to us. Over,

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Roger. I'm going to be setting them to zero for the undocking. The question is do you want me to reset 405 and 406 back to the numbers that they are now, or can I leave them zero? I intend to set 404 to a minus 13495. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Stand by. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. We would like you to zero, as called out in the timeline, all three addresses, 404, 405, 406, before undocking. After undocking, you can load them back to the values that you have right now. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Eagle. Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: And, Houston, Eagle here. Both RCS helium pressures are reading 2,900. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Copy. Out.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Eagle, Houston. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Go ahead.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Rog, Buzz. Seems to be some confusion here on 405 and 406. We'd like you to zero them out prior to undocking, and after undocking you can - we'd like them still zeroed. Over.

a11_0983758.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0983758.text: Rog. I agree with that. Thank you.

a11_0983758.speaker: Duke
a11_0983758.text: Yep.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. We've got the load in, the - We have reselected P00. Your integration is going again for you, the computer is yours. We'd like to do the drift check now. Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0990325.text: Columbia, let's flick it in 06 20 when you're ready.

a11_0990325.speaker: Collins
a11_0990325.text: Standing by for your Mark, Neil. [Pause.]

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. We've copied the angles and will read back if you are ready. Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0990325.text: That's correct, and GET was 99 hours and 4 minutes even.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. Have you initialized the AGS yet? Over. [Pause.]

a11_0990325.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0990325.text: Negative. I haven't had a state vector yet.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Rog, Buzz. Have you done the 377 yet?

a11_0990325.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0990325.text: Roger. Standing by for your K-factor.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Columbia, Houston. We got a load for you. Could we have P00 and Accept? Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Roger. Thank you, Mike. And break. Eagle, we've got a K-factor for you. Over. [Pause.]

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Roger, Buzz. K-factor coming at you: 90 00 00 15. Over. [Pause.]

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Rog. That's good. That's a good Enter there.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. We recommend the AGS initial - Well, we see it coming up now on the AGS initialization. Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. After the AGS initialization, we'll be ready for the RCS checkout.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Columbia, Houston. We got the load in. You can go back to Block.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Columbia, Houston. Did you get a - copy any LM data, low bit rate, behind the Moon? Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Collins
a11_0990325.text: Or at least I've configured for it. I'm not sure Eagle sent it or not.

a11_0990325.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0990325.text: No, we did not send B-Data. Eagle. Over.

a11_0990325.speaker: Duke
a11_0990325.text: Eagle, Houston. The alignment and the initialization look good to us. Over. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Apollo 11, Houston. LOS is 99:30; next AOS, 100:16. Over. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: 100:16. Roger. [Long pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Eagle, Columbia. Let me know when you come to your RCS hot-fire checks so I can disable my roll.

a11_0991527.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0991527.text: Wilco.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Rog. We're right there now. And we'd like you in - CSM in mid-deadband Att Hold. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: That's where I am.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: And, Houston, you have high bit rate with us now, I believe? We're ready to proceed with the RCS checks.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Rog, Eagle. We're standing by. We're ready. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Columbia, we'd like wide deadband Att Hold. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Okay. Going wide deadband Att Hold. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: You got it. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Are you going to do your hot-fire now?

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Roger.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Okay. I'm disabling my roll. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Roll is disabled.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Roger.

a11_0991527.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0991527.text: This is Apollo Control. We have less than 10 minutes now until Loss Of Signal on the twelfth revolution. Before losing contact with the spacecraft, we'll be passing along a Go/No-Go decision for undocking. That will occur early on the next revolution just prior to reacquiring the spacecraft. Flight Director Gene Kranz is going around the control center now, talking to his flight controllers, reviewing status in preparation for making the Go/No-Go decision for undocking.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: I do believe you've got thrusters on board that vehicle. [Long pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Give me a call just as soon as your hot-fire is complete, please.

a11_0991527.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0991527.text: Wilco.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Houston, Eagle. The RCS hot-fire is complete. How did you observe it? Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Stand by. [Pause.] Eagle, Houston. The RCS hot-fire looks super to us. We're all Go.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Roger. Mike, would you confirm that thruster B3 and C4 are Off? Over. And your radar transponder off.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: C4 is Off, B3 is Off. Transponder is to Heater which is the same as being Off, and I've got my roll jets back on now.

a11_0991527.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0991527.text: And you're maneuvering. Right?

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Will be shortly, Neil. [Pause.]

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Apollo 11, Houston. We're Go for undocking. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Roger. Understand.

a11_0991527.speaker: Armstrong
a11_0991527.text: [Garble].

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Starting a trim maneuver to AGS CAL attitude.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Houston, Columbia.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Go ahead, Columbia. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Roger. There'll be no television of the undocking. I have all available windows either full of heads or cameras, and I'm busy with other things.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: We concur. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Okay.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: And, Eagle, Houston. We'd like you to select aft Omni now. It will be good for both LOS and AOS. Over.

a11_0991527.speaker: Aldrin
a11_0991527.text: Roger. Going to aft Omni.

a11_0991527.speaker: Duke
a11_0991527.text: Apollo 11, Houston. One minute to LOS.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: Columbia. Rog.

a11_0991527.speaker: Collins
a11_0991527.text: How are Columbia's systems looking to you guys?.

a11_0991527.speaker: Mission Control
a11_0991527.text: This is Apollo Control. We've had Loss Of Signal now. We'll reacquire the spacecraft again on the thirteenth revolution in about 45 minutes. At the end of this pass, we passed along the Go for undocking. That maneuver will occur just before we re-acquire the spacecraft on the thirteenth revolution and will be followed in about 30 - 30 minutes - about 30 minutes later by a small separation maneuver performed by Mike Collins in the Command Module. Checkout of the LM has been going extremely well up to now, ahead of schedule. Both vehicles look very good. At 99 hours, 31 minutes; this is Apollo C

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Okay with you if I start my pitch, or you think you're not far enough away yet, Mike?

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: I'd prefer you stand by just a couple of seconds, Neil.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Okay. I'll wait for when you're ready - when you think you've got your rates killed perfectly.

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Okay. I'm still holding [garble].

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: [Garble.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Okay, looks pretty good to me now.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Okay.

a11_1001400.speaker: Mission Control
a11_1001400.text: We have confirmation of Acquisition Of Signal. We'll stand by for a call to the crew.

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Just like in the simulator, you're drifting off to one side and down below a little bit.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Yes.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Hello, Eagle. Houston. We're standing by. Over. [No answer.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: The gear are looking good. I've seen three of them.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: The MESA is not down, right?

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Say again.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: The MESA's still up?

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Yes.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Good.

a11_1001400.speaker: Unknown speaker (may be a previous utterance)
a11_1001400.text: [Garble].

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Now, you're looking good.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Eagle, Houston. We - Houston. We see you on the steerable. Over. [Pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Roger. Eagle's undocked.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Roger. How does it look, Neil?

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: The Eagle has wings.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Rog.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Looking good.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Roger, Neil. We got a - If you'll give us P00 and Data, we've got some loads for you. [Pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1001400.text: Okay. You've got it. P00 and Data.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Roger. Let us know when you're ready to copy. We have a DOI PAD, the - and the PDI PAD. Over. [Long pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: You check our tracking light, Mike? [Long pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: It came on.

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Camera's working beautifully.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Track off?

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: It's off.

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Okay, I'm ready to start my yaw maneuver if it suits you, Mike. [Long pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1001400.text: Does it look like you're gonna be able to do this without burning thrusters, Mike? [Long pause.]

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: I'd have to fire laterally once or twice.

a11_1001400.speaker: Collins
a11_1001400.text: Very small.

a11_1001400.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1001400.text: Go ahead, Houston. Eagle is ready to copy.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Roger, Eagle. Coming at you with a DOI PAD: 101:36:14.07. Noun 81, minus 00758, plus all balls, plus 00098, plus - correction, 00572, perigee plus 00085 00764 030 000 293. Noun 86, minus 00759, plus all balls, plus 00090. Rest of the PAD is NA. Stand by on your readback. If you are ready to copy the PDI data, I have it for you. Over.

a11_1001400.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1001400.text: Go ahead.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Understand you are ready to copy the PDI data, Eagle. Over.

a11_1001400.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1001400.text: That's affirmative. Go ahead with the PDI.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Roger. PDI PAD: T IG 102:33:04.36; 09:50, minus 00021; 182, 287, 000; plus 56919. PDI abort, less than 10 minutes, 105:12:30.00. PDI abort, greater than 10 minutes, 103:40:00.00, 107:11:30.00. No PDI plus 12: 102:44:27.00. Noun 81, plus 01223, minus all balls, plus 01889; 01520, plus 00110, 02250. Burn time, 0:46; 000, 190; plus 01187, plus all balls, plus 01911. Noun 11, 103:31:07.00. Noun 37, 105:12:30.00. Ready for your readbacks, Over.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: Eagle, Houston. We're through with the computer. You can go back to Block. Over.

a11_1001400.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1001400.text: Roger. Back to Block, and DOI: 101:36:14.07. Minus 0075.8, plus all zeros, plus 0009.8, 0057.2, plus 0008.5, 0076.4, 030, 000, 293; minus 0075.9, plus all zeros, plus 0009.0; NA. Over.

a11_1001400.speaker: Duke
a11_1001400.text: That was a good readback, Buzz. Go ahead. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Neil, I'm maneuvering in roll.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Rog. I see you.

a11_1002902.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1002902.text: Houston, Eagle. Are you copying the fairly large numbers for range and range rate in - Verb 83? And did - did you just give us a state vector that changed one of the two vehicles? Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Roger, Eagle. We gave you a LM state vector. We have not changed the CSM state vector, however. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1002902.text: Okay. That explains the difference. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Columbia, Houston. On my Mark, 9:30 to ignition.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Mark.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: 9:30. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Eagle, Houston. Would you have Columbia go to the High Gain, yaw 0, pitch minus 20. Over. [Pause.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: You want him to go to High Gain, yaw, zero, ah - say again the numbers.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Rog, Neil. Yaw 0, pitch minus 20, High Gain angles. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Okay. Yaw zero, pitch minus 20, on the High Gain.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: That's affirmative. We've lost all data with him.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Yes, I copy that, and I'll do it just as soon as I get to it.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: To Columbia?

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Okay, he says he'll do that as soon as he gets around there.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Rog.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Okay, Neil, I'm all set for the Sep burn, and we're looking good on this phasing.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Columbia, Houston. How do you read?

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Columbia reading you loud and clear, Houston. How me?

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Roger, Mike. Five-by. On my mark, 7 minutes 'til ignition.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Mark.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Seven minutes.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: I agree. Everything's looking real good. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Mission Control
a11_1002902.text: This is Apollo Control. We're now 6 minutes, 8 seconds from ignition and...

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Apollo 11, Houston. You are looking good for separation. You are Go for separation, Columbia. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Columbia understands. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: We're really stabilized, Neil. I haven't fired a thruster in 5 minutes. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: I'll make a small trim maneuver? [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Mike, what's going to be your pitch angle at Sep?

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: 007 degrees.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Is that close enough for you, or do you want it to a couple of decimal places?

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: No. That's good. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: I think you've got a fine looking flying machine there, Eagle, despite the fact you're upside down.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: Somebody's upside down.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: There you go. One minute 'til T IG . You guys take care.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: See you later. [Long Pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Thrusting. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Houston, Columbia. My DSKY is reading 4.9 in X, 5.0 make it, and EMS 105.4. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Roger. Copy. Columbia, it looks good to us. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Thanks. [Long pause.]

a11_1002902.speaker: Duke
a11_1002902.text: Columbia, Houston. We'd like you to terminate average G. Over.

a11_1002902.speaker: Collins
a11_1002902.text: Roger. In P00.

a11_1002902.speaker: Mission Control
a11_1002902.text: This is Apollo Control. That separation maneuver was performed as scheduled, giving the Command Module a Delta-V of about 2.5 feet per second, which should give a separation to the two vehicles of about 1,100 feet at the beginning of the Descent Orbit Insertion maneuver.

a11_1002902.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1002902.text: You're going right down US-1, Mike.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Eagle, Columbia. At your convenience, I'd like to switch over to VHF ranging mode.

a11_1004720.speaker: Aldrin
a11_1004720.text: Roger. Let's go to VHF ranging now.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Okay.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Mark. [Long pause.]

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Eagle, Columbia. I'm reading you loud and scratchy. Neil is not coming through too well on his VOX. Could you stay quiet for 15 seconds while I get this locked on.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: I've got a solid lock on. I have you at 0.27 miles. [Long pause.]

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
a11_1004720.text: Eagle, Houston. We've got a state vector for you. We'd like P00 and Data. Over.

a11_1004720.speaker: Armstrong
a11_1004720.text: You have it.

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
a11_1004720.text: Thank you, sir. [Long pause.]

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
a11_1004720.text: Columbia, Houston. We have a CSM rescue PAD if you're ready to copy. Over.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Ready to copy.

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
a11_1004720.text: Rog, Mike. Phasing T IG 103:40:00.00. TPI for PDI less than 10, 105:12:30.00. TPI for PDI greater than 10, 107:11:30.00. Over.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Roger. T IG s follow: phasing 103:40. PDI less than 10, 105:12:30. More than 10, 107:11:30. Over.

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
a11_1004720.text: Good readback. Out.

a11_1004720.speaker: Collins
a11_1004720.text: Okay. [Long pause.]

a11_1004720.speaker: Duke
